summary: First iteration testing of NivXary. Ran 19 pytest backend tests (all passing) and full Playwright UI test covering login, workspace 3-column layout, operations panel (45 ops, search filter), example load, smart decode, individual base64 op flow, analyze+OSINT, admin OSINT key save, logout. All core flows work as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 670 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, analyze) for maintainability.
CORS uses wildcard '*' from CORS_ORIGINS env default — acceptable for preview but should be tightened for prod.
TROUBLESHOOT/AI endpoints depend on external LLM and have no rate-limiting; acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: admin@nivxary.com / NivXary#2026! (documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty; credentials were provided in review request and confirmed working via seeded admin on backend startup).
seed_data_creation: None (admin user auto-seeded by backend). Test-created OSINT VirusTotal key was cleaned up in fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_nivxary.py — 19 tests covering auth, operations (45), examples (5), smart decode (all 5 examples with content assertions for powershell/xss/defanged), recipe run, analyze, admin OSINT CRUD. Frontend Playwright verified: login (valid+invalid), workspace 3-column, ops search filter (base64 => 7 matches), example load, SMART DECODE outputs correct powershell IEX+192.168.1.1 URL, individual base64-decode op flow returns 'Hello World', ANALYZE + OSINT populates 185.220.101.45 as Tor/proxy correctly, admin OSINT key save persists with masked key, logout redirects. All data-testids present and reliable. AI DECODE / AI DESCRIBE / AUTO INVESTIGATE not exercised in UI but backend routes exist; per review request AI is optional/best-effort.
